robotstxt:
{{doc-special|RobotsTxt}}
Name of the special page that serves the robots.txt file. It is a plain-text endpoint, so this name is only seen in Special:SpecialPages. "robots.txt" is a file name and should normally not be translated.
robotstxt-lint-intro: Introduction of a warning box shown above the edit form of the page MediaWiki:Robots.txt, followed by a list of problems found in the text. "robots.txt" is a file name and should not be translated. "Crawlers" are automated programs of search engines that read the file.
robotstxt-lint-nocolon:
Item of the list in the warning box shown when editing MediaWiki:Robots.txt. The line of the text has no colon, so a crawler cannot read it.

Parameters:
* $1 - line number in the edit box, counted from 1
* $2 - the text of the line (shortened when it is very long). Do not translate it.
robotstxt-lint-orphan:
Item of the list in the warning box shown when editing MediaWiki:Robots.txt. An Allow or Disallow rule appears before the first User-agent line, so it belongs to no group and crawlers ignore it. "Allow", "Disallow" and "User-agent" are directive names of the robots.txt format and should not be translated.

Parameters:
* $1 - line number in the edit box, counted from 1
* $2 - the text of the line (shortened when it is very long). Do not translate it.
robotstxt-lint-path:
Item of the list in the warning box shown when editing MediaWiki:Robots.txt. The value of an Allow or Disallow rule does not start with a slash (/) or an asterisk (*), so it matches nothing. "Allow" and "Disallow" are directive names of the robots.txt format and should not be translated.

Parameters:
* $1 - line number in the edit box, counted from 1
* $2 - the text of the line (shortened when it is very long). Do not translate it.
robotstxt-lint-more:
Last item of the list in the warning box shown when editing MediaWiki:Robots.txt, used when there are more problems than the box lists.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of problems that are not listed
